0022600124.text: Phoenix (1-1, second in the Pacific and 1.5 games back, ninth in the West) is on the road against Oklahoma City (2-0, first in the Northwest and third in the West), and this is the Suns' third game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Phoenix lost the 2025-26 season series 2-3 and was swept 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, with the most recent meeting on April 27, 2026, a 131-122 Suns loss in Phoenix. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and is a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery).
